### Added
- **`modelServing.additionalRuntimes`: more vLLM `ClusterServingRuntime`s beside the default, rendered from the same template** (giantswarm/agent-platform#550). `modelServing.runtime` rendered exactly one runtime and every preset ran on it; an installation whose accelerator needs a different serving image for some models — a hardware-specific vLLM build for a unified-memory Blackwell node next to the upstream image the other presets run on — had to move every preset to that image or hand-write a runtime outside the chart. The new list renders one `ClusterServingRuntime` per entry: `name` required, a DNS-1123 subdomain and unique across the default and the list (a name already used fails the render naming the entry); every other field — `image` (registry, name, version), `args`, `env`, `resources`, `shmSize`, `startupProbe`, `annotations`, `supportedModelFormats`, `nodeSelector`, `tolerations` — the default runtime's where the entry leaves it unset (a mapping field by field, a list whole: an entry's `env` replaces the default's two entries rather than extending them; an empty value inherits too); the GPU pool's taint and label applied as on the default; the container on the same shell entrypoint (`/bin/sh -c 'eval "exec vllm serve $@"' --`) with the entry's own base arguments, so its image must carry `/bin/sh` and `vllm` on `PATH` as well. A preset selects a runtime with `spec.runtime`. The discovery ConfigMap publishes every runtime's name as `spec.runtimes` (the default first) next to `spec.runtime`; an empty list renders the default alone, and the default runtime's document is unchanged. Mirrored in the meta chart, and `tests/verify-mirrored-values.py` (`make verify-meta`) now holds the `modelServing.runtime` and `modelServing.additionalRuntimes` blocks equal between the charts too — an additional runtime inherits from the forwarded default. `make verify-runtimes` asserts the render over `ci/test-model-serving-runtimes-values.yaml` (inheritance, the pool on every runtime, the entrypoint, the discovery list, the guards, the meta chart's forwarded render); README "Additional runtimes".
